name: Review shipment exceptions
goal: Read ShipStation when its API is available; otherwise use the newest shipments CSV in incoming/. Save possible freight exceptions for the shipper to confirm and make no external changes.

config.template:
Shipment exception review. The report names whether it used ShipStation or a CSV export. Possible matches require customer confirmation; no claim was filed and no carrier was contacted.

{summary}

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import os,json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures/freight-claims/reports/shipstation-candidates.json'; d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert d.get('result') in ('match','uncertain — please check') or d.get('result','').startswith('no match found in ShipStation as of '); assert d.get('side_effects',[]) == [] and all(x.get('customer_confirmation_required') for x in d.get('candidates',[]))"
